args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (unbounded recursion
when parsing deeply nested arrays). 2.9.4 is the first fixed release
in the 2.x line, so bump the pin to 2.9.4.

args.body:
## What
Bumps the fastjson pin in `requirements.txt` from `2.8.0` to `2.9.4`.

## Why
fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Affected range is `<2.9.4, >=3.0.0 <3.1.0`, so `2.9.4` is the first fixed release in the 2.x line.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `c8b8ab7878` passed.
args.head: fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
